ingameEffects.label: Energetic Strike (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: Increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency. When the equipper is an Ether character, and comes on-field or uses a Special Attack or EX Special Attack, they gain a buff: DMG dealt to enemies afflicted with Attribute Anomalies increases, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG they trigger increases by a percentage, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration, and the effect is removed when switching off-field.
